title: DocGuard recorded document reviews
description: What each document review checked (specs/095-recorded-document-reviews): the commit, the reason and a fingerprint of every file the document referenced. Written only by `docguard review --accept <doc>`. Forward compatibility: a future field goes under an `extensions` object (top level, per document or per reference), which every reader ignores; any other unknown field is an error, reported as FRS010, so an older reader never misreads a newer file silently.

extensions.description: Reserved for future fields; ignored by readers of schemaVersion 1.

documents.description: Keyed by the document's project-relative POSIX path.

reviewedRevision.description: HEAD when the review was recorded: the review point FRS006 and FRS007 measure from.

excluded.description: Referenced paths not measured, with the reason (directory, vendored copy, changelog/lockfile/claims data, test or fixture data, linguist-generated, generated-by header, under 20 lines).
